items.summary: fix(agents): reconcile late requester recovery receipts (#155357) Observe exact late requester recovery receipts before returning an eligible retryable handoff outcome. Reuse the existing short-lived worker reader and response classifier without dispatching the input again. Preserve ownership/cancellation boundaries, committed and ambiguous results, explicit stops, permanent outcomes, and private/incognito exclusions. Keep the repair scoped to the three reviewed announce files. No registry, transaction, schema, dependency or worker-framework changes. Validation: exact-head CI 35726842329 passed both required gates and all 23 authored regressions. Current-context native run 35729961457 passed the existing final-response/same-session-follow-up case on the explicitly bound production-plus-fixture composite, with fulfilled cleanup and verified native/host closure. Other E2E branches retain their historical proof; no authenticated external-provider or release acceptance is claimed.
